players.product: PECVD (Stack ONO, ACHM hard-mask) and ALD thin-film deposition tools for 3D NAND and advanced memory, plus hybrid-bonding tools

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: revenue RMB 65.19 hundred million, up 58.87%, as new products and processes for advanced nodes reached volume production; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 9.27 hundred million (+34.67%); net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 7.23 hundred million (+103.05%). Main-business gross margin 34.01%, down 6.90 percentage points. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 708,702,693.06, Q2 RMB 1,245,443,480.59, Q3 RMB 2,265,963,233.59, Q4 RMB 2,298,985,467.39. Operating cash flow RMB 36.33 hundred million (2024: -RMB 282,525,331.06) as advance payments and sales collections reached RMB 94.84 hundred million. All main-business revenue came from mainland China, sold direct.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 revenue RMB 65.19 hundred million (+58.87%); net profit RMB 9.27 hundred million (+34.67%); recurring net profit RMB 7.23 hundred million (+103.05%); gross margin 34.01%

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 revenue by product: PECVD about RMB 51.42 hundred million (+75.27%), as PECVD Stack (ONO), ACHM and PECVD Bianca tools built on the new PF-300T Plus and PF-300M platforms with the new pX and Supra-D chambers passed customer validation in batches and entered volume production for advanced memory and advanced logic; ALD about RMB 3.01 hundred million (+191.82%) as PE-ALD SiO2, SiN and SiCO tools scaled up and the first Thermal-ALD TiN tool passed customer validation; hybrid bonding RMB 1.36 hundred million (+41.92%) on continued wafer-to-wafer hybrid-bonding orders and validations, plus the first wafer-to-wafer fusion bonder passing customer validation.
quarterly_data.figure: PECVD RMB 51.42 hundred million (+75.27%); ALD RMB 3.01 hundred million (+191.82%); hybrid bonding RMB 1.36 hundred million (+41.92%)

quarterly_data.signal: Order book at end-2025: orders on hand of about RMB 110 hundred million; contract liabilities RMB 48.52 hundred million, up 62.66% on much higher customer prepayments. The company added several new customers, won orders from overseas customers and says orders on hand are full.
quarterly_data.figure: orders on hand about RMB 110 hundred million; contract liabilities RMB 48.52 hundred million (+62.66%)

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 output and installed base: produced 316 tools (-7.60%), sold 250 (+32.98%), inventory 391 (+20.31%, mainly goods shipped to customers). By end-2025 it had shipped over 3,400 reaction chambers (over 400 of the new pX and Supra-D chambers, over 80 PECVD Bianca chambers, over 140 ALD, over 150 SACVD and over 120 HDPCVD chambers) into about 100 production lines, with average uptime above 90%; cumulative wafers processed on its deposition tools passed 4.57 hundred million, over 2.1 hundred million in 2025 alone. Its tools support about 100-plus process applications in logic and memory.
quarterly_data.figure: sold 250 tools (+32.98%); over 3,400 chambers shipped; about 100 production lines; uptime above 90%

quarterly_data.signal: Product progress in 2025: PECVD Supra-D OPN, SiB and high-temperature SiN tools for advanced memory passed customer validation and keep winning orders; the higher-throughput NF-300M Supra-H platform (four six-station chambers, up to 24 wafers at a time, for multilayer ONO stacks) finished prototype build and is in process optimisation and validation; the first plasma-enhanced SAF SACVD tool passed customer validation; Flowable CVD was selected by a customer as its POR tool. 3D integration: Dione 300 wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonders won repeat orders and are in volume use; the next-generation Dione 300eX shipped to a customer for validation; the Dione 300FeX fusion bonder completed validation at an advanced-logic customer; the Pleione 300 die-to-wafer hybrid bonder (for HBM and 3D chip integration) is in customer validation; Propus 300 pre-bond surface treatment won repeat orders; Crux300 overlay metrology and Ascella300 bond-strength tools passed customer validation; the Lyra300 post-bond laser debonder was developed.
quarterly_data.figure: NF-300M Supra-H processes up to 24 wafers at a time

quarterly_data.signal: Top five customers: sales RMB 515,963.64 ten-thousand, 79.15% of 2025 sales; the largest 52.93% (RMB 345,078.37 ten-thousand), then 13.69%, 5.18%, 4.78% and 2.56%; names not disclosed; related-party sales RMB 35,337.73 ten-thousand, 5.42% of sales (within the second customer). The company says the largest customer exceeded 50% because it entered an expansion cycle and Piotech's products passed its validation in batches; the fourth customer is new to the top five in 2025. Top five suppliers: RMB 164,465.33 ten-thousand, 31.93% of purchases; the largest 12.55%; one related-party supplier (2.97%), new to the top five in 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: top five customers 79.15% of 2025 sales (RMB 515,963.64 ten-thousand); largest customer 52.93%; top five suppliers 31.93% of purchases

quarterly_data.signal: R&D: 2025 R&D investment RMB 859,274,227.88 (+13.66%), 13.18% of revenue (2024: 18.42%), of which 10.44% capitalised; 726 R&D staff, 42.81% of employees; 2,140 patent applications and 707 granted patents cumulatively.

Capacity projects: the Shanghai second plant in Lingang (about 9 ten-thousand square metres, for advanced ALD R&D and industrialisation; construction budget RMB 74,097.24 ten-thousand) came into use in 2025 and the project was closed, lifting fixed assets 89.34%. Construction of the Shenyang second plant (over 15 ten-thousand square metres planned; construction budget RMB 161,648.08 ten-thousand, 7.98% invested at end-2025) has started; the raised-fund table gives April 2029 as the project's ready-for-use date.
quarterly_data.figure: Shanghai second plant about 9 ten-thousand square metres, in use; Shenyang second plant budget RMB 161,648.08 ten-thousand, 7.98% invested
